Other words

  • praedō, praedōnis m. — a robber, a plunderer

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. praedō; Traupman 195 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • grex, gregis m. — a gang, a troop

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 320 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • praedō gregālis — gangster, gang member

    also used · modern · Traupman 320

    gregālis is classical, and in a bad sense “of the common herd” (Lewis & Short). Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.
